steps.element_description: API documentation navigation menu containing endpoint categories.
Detailed information about the endpoint, including request and response schemas.

potential_user_journeys.scenario_description: A user downloads the OpenAPI specification for integration into their project.
expected_outcome: OpenAPI specification file is downloaded successfully.

explored_pages_and_scenarios.page_title: API Documentation for Create Test Plan

potential_user_journeys.scenario_description: User accesses the API endpoint to configure and create a new test plan including integration details and AI model configurations.

steps.element_description: Enter test plan name in the input field.
Choose AI model configuration from the dropdown.
Submit the test plan creation request using the API POST method.

expected_outcome: A new test plan is successfully created and available for further configurations.

potential_user_journeys.scenario_description: A user configures the RoostGPT for testing their AI models.

steps.element_description: Enter the Roost Token in the text field.

expected_outcome: Test suite is set up for execution.
